intervention_policy: withdraw from work lists after 24 hours only after a verified permanent OneDrive archive
project_policy: 15 days completed, 30 days archived, source OneDrive folder preserved
permanent_archive: known source attachments and imported PDFs
batch_index_write: one conditional write after archive verification
desktop_activation: Storage panel; isolated by account and drive; periodic while app remains open
closed_app_execution: requires configured service and permanent-onedrive-v1 policy marker
